tasks.instruction: Drone Drone 5 performs sequential multi-target mission: take off to 21 meters, visit targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 1, and Polygon Target 2 in sequence. At each target, get within the target radius, hover for observation, and take a photo. Plan optimal route to minimize flight distance.
Drone Drone 3 takes off to 14 meters altitude, then rotates to face heading 353 degrees and hovers.

Drone Drone 17 should take off to 15 meters altitude, fly to pickup point at (337, 319, 15), land to collect goods, then take off again to 15 meters, fly to delivery point at (651, 505, 15), and land to complete delivery.

Communication relay mission: Drone Drone 11 acts as communication relay. Take off to 19 meters, position at relay point (542, 421, 19). Send broadcast messages to coordinate with other drones. Send at least 3 messages total during the mission.

Drones Drone 19 and Drone 6 form a line formation: both take off to 17 meters. Drone 19 positions at (565, 428, 17) and Drone 6 flys to (579, 437, 17) first, and then move to 23 meters at most to Drone 19. Both maintain formation for monitoring.

Drones Drone 22, Drone 6, and Drone 30 execute coordinated search sweep of target area Circle Target 3. All take off to 24 meters. Drones maintain parallel formation 21.4 meters apart and sweep through the target area in synchronized pattern. Each drone takes photos during sweep.
Drone 7 executes comprehensive area search of Circle Target 8. Take off to 22 meters and perform a systematic coverage pattern to search at least 95% of the target area using an efficient pattern.
Drone Drone 7 performs photo documentation mission: take off to 19 meters, visit three waypoints at (280, 217, 19), (471, 616, 19), and (755, 790, 19). At each waypoint, take a photo.
